answer: A relic dangles above the harbor mirror, its weight metered by tide-clock pulses. Each identity must toll 0.01 walnut coins per pulse—coins fused irreversibly into the chain’s ledger. To forge a twin, sink 0.01 walnut more; the tide won’t reroll its meter, so every extra fake is immediately overloaded by 0.01 walnut, plus 0.89s of serial tolling.
